dct_description_sm:
This is a dataset of information compiled for the Heritage documentation and recording information management of the Core Course on “Site Planning and Management of Conservation Projects”, for Al-Quds University Abu Dis students.  This course is supported by Taawon´s Old Cities Jerusalem Revitalization Program with a generous fund from Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development. 
The course was taught by Professor Mario Santana of Carleton University. The compiled data will use to produce a Heritage Recording of this important Site by Al Quds students.  This material can not be used for commercial purposes or use in any form without the permission of Taawon´s Old Cities Jerusalem Revitalization Program, Dr. Mario Santana, the authors, and site custodians.
dct_title_s: Erikak Houses (Abu Dis, West Bank, Palestine)
